user.description:
Enter your API keys to set up the integration.

**NASA API Key** (required): Get yours free at [api.nasa.gov]({nasa_url})

**Rocket Launch Live API Key** (optional): Get yours at [rocketlaunch.live]({rocket_url}) — leave blank for free tier (no media links)
